title: dactylorhiza × thellungiana
intro: Dactylorhiza × thellungiana, commonly known as the Thellungiella hybrid, is a rare and hybrid species of orchid, resulting from the cross between Dactylorhiza cespitosa and Coeloglossum viride. This plant is valued for its medicinal properties, particularly in traditional Chinese medicine, where it is believed to offer health benefits such as reducing inflammation, relieving pain, and promoting cardiovascular health. The therapeutic actions of Dactylorhiza × thellungiana are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic acids, which exhibit antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and vasodilatory properties. However, due to its limited availability and lack of comprehensive research, more studies are needed to confirm the full extent of its health benefits and therapeutic applications.
